game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Customs House, the port customs house: the shipwright must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Signal Logic: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings.
theme: Coastal Port – Customs House: the port customs house
core_gameplay_loop: In Customs House, repeat each round: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings. Each round, a new ship ropes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the safety value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 240 points of ship ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 240, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Signal Logic
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Signal Logic' (Week 3 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Customs House'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Customs House.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 240 within 67 seconds.
